text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right!
—The 'Voice of Destiny' says so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want to know! I want to check for sure!
In that case, let's ask everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, you over thereee!!

Some time has passed since I started
training together with Epiphaneia.
And as always, she's running me in circles.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I feel destiny with you!
What about you!?
Apparently, Epiphaneia sometimes feels "destiny" calling out to other Umamusume... The moment I take my eyes off her, she occasionally goes up to talk to them like this.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Destiny...? I don't really get stuff like that, but...
Epi-san... I don't dislike you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! In that case,
keep watching me until 'don't dislike' turns into destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tell me!
Do you feel destiny between us?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I felt it~!
Ahaha, this is unreal~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I don't really feel destiny!
Though I do feel a happy aura☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I don't really understand
destiny either.
...Though, maybe it could be useful for fan service?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Still not good enough!
choice_data_list: Umm... were you checking on something?
Umm... were you checking on something?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The distance to our dream, that is!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to
awaken the voice of destiny within everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, first I gotta make them
feel like it's destiny!
Otherwise, I won't be able to awaken their voice!"
choice_data_list: (I kind of get it, but also kind of don't...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I really do have to win in races.
And not just any—in THAT race!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
—Let's go watch!
(W A A A A H !)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOH!!
Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes!!

"A fierce wave of enthusiasm enveloped the venue. And for good reason...
For what came next was the Japanese Derby."
"The second leg of the traditional Classic Triple Crown races, which only Umamusume in the Classic Class can challenge."

A race of immense significance to the racing world,
often called the dream of everyone involved in the sport—

Drawing massive attention this year is
the Satsuki Sho Umamusume, Gold Ship.
Will she dynamically claim her second crown, or—
Or will a talented, serious Umamusume like Fenomeno rise to the top...?

—My chest swells with passion.
To any Trainer, this stage
holds a truly special meaning.
choice_data_list: (Someday, I'll become a Derby Trainer too...!)
(Someday, I want to become a Derby Trainer too...!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, your eyes are sparkling too...
So dazzling and beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You really look up to the Derby, don't you!
choice_data_list: I bet you feel the same way, right?
I'm sure you feel the same way, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Longing?
Hardly!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The Derby is—a race that I have to win!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Meno
text_block_list.text:
—Uwooooooh!!!!
—Oraaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
" 'Gooooo!!' 'Mejirooo!!'
'Golshi, sweep past 'em! Sweep!' 'Do your best!'
'Woooaaaaahhh...!!!!' "

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Nnnngh, guhh!
—Just a little... moreee...!!

The result was a thrilling nose-to-nose finish that sent the crowd into a frenzy.
Bathed in thunderous applause, the winner's face
beamed with pure elation...

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
The winner is incredible... She's so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to win someday too――
just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!
You!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You just felt destiny with that girl, didn't you!
Admit it, you did, right!?

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
D-Destiny?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing the winner gave you the motivation to try hard too!
It gave you strength, didn't it!?"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah... y-yes!
Inside my chest, something shone like a star—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's it!
That very radiance is—destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's a destiny...
that I must make them feel!
After the race, when I asked Epiphaneia again about the "destiny she needed to make them feel"—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"No one else can hear the voice of destiny"...
When I first found out, I was so surprised!

text_block_list.name: Young Epi
text_block_list.text: "See? Even the voice of destiny says so! So follow my lead, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Epi's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny...? What's that?
Epi-chan is saying weird stuff again~"
"Ahahahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that blessed voice, I was able to move forward toward happiness without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If only everyone could hear that voice too...
I could clear away their doubts and anxiety!
Just as I was thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Young Epi
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!!
I'm number one!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In my very first Kiddie Race, I won!
Naturally—I am beloved by destiny, after all!
But what surprised me was—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...! So cool~!"
"That girl is amazing!"
"Her name is Epiphaneia-chan, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"With sparkling eyes, those kids looked at me.
I felt it—our destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Young Epi
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! Why's that!?
I feel a sparkle coming from you guys...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: "Me too—!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, me too...!
And also—I heard them say to follow Epi-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I had a divine revelation!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone and I are connected by destiny.
If I win right in front of those kids—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You can awaken the voices
sleeping within everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In other words, by winning,
I can guide everyone toward happiness!!
"To be honest, I think it's an absurd dream. But at its core... lies pure goodwill: the desire to 'make everyone happy.'"
choice_data_list: (I want to make those feelings come true)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—That's what
the Derby is all about!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is the most watched race...
If I win here, everyone will be looking at me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You're bound to feel our destiny—
shining bright like a star!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And not just any star.
A fixed star that shines the brightest in this universe—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It is the sun that illuminates everything far and wide!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I'll win the Derby and become the sun!

"Indeed, the influence of a Derby Umamusume is tremendous.
It is... possible that a girl influenced by that could feel
something only an Umamusume could truly understand."
choice_data_list: (Believe in her and give Epi a push forward.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Next year!
Next year on this very day—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
—Look forward to it!
